description: naturf is a Python workflow that calculates urban building parameters for the Weather Research and Forecasting model. The JOSS paper and own README say it derives 132 parameters from footprint and height shapefiles and exports WRF-ready binary input. Spatial coverage and resolution depend on the building layers chosen, and temporal coverage follows their survey date and the later weather scenario. The public repository reports MIT. The generated urban morphology can help evaluate heat islands, wind and neighbourhood climate exposure in infrastructure simulations. A caveat is that missing buildings or wrong heights propagate into the weather model, and generated parameters do not validate WRF predictions. The package supplies inputs, not an observed heat record. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own source were read without obtaining building data or running WRF.
name: naturf urban parameters for WRF
